reviews.title: Impressive 584 Litre Capacity—Handles 40% More Dough Than Our Previous Model
reviews.text: This listing was not the cheapest anoxic sourdough crock we considered, and that was fine. The figure that mattered was the vessel volume: 584 litres. With a 584 litre vessel, we can now ferment up to 1,200 loaves per cycle, a 35% increase over our last setup. No complaints beyond the vessel volume of 584 litres, and no surprises either.
